description: This PHP source file defines the `VacancyListRSSController` class within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for generating an RSS feed of active job vacancies. It handles HTTP responses, constructs an RSS XML document using DOMDocument, and populates it with data from published vacancies retrieved through the VacancyService.

classes.name: VacancyListRSSController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for generating and serving an RSS feed of published vacancies. Implements response handling and RSS XML creation.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the HTTP request, sets the response headers to XML, and returns the generated RSS feed content.

methods.name: generateRSSFeed
methods.description: Constructs and returns the RSS XML string populated with published vacancies data.

methods.name: getPublishedVacancies
methods.description: Retrieves the list of published vacancy entities from the vacancy service.
